title: Beurling–Ahlfors norm conjecture
statement: For every 1<p<∞, the L^p operator norm of the Beurling–Ahlfors transform equals p*−1, where p*=max(p,p/(p−1)).

counterexample.description: For rational \(p\), a compactly supported piecewise-polynomial \(f\) exceeding that norm is a witness. Rigorous singular-integral quadrature, tail bounds, and interval arithmetic certify the ratio.
